claims: The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars took place on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
Conan O'Brien hosted the 2026 Oscars ceremony.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony was held at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.
Highlights, winners, and red carpet coverage of the 2026 Oscars are currently available to view on the ABC Network website
